title: Handley Page Halifax LV905
memorial_details: description: Part of a WW2 aircraft engine (probably a Bristol Hercules radial engine from a Halifax bomber), set on a gravel base within a low brick wall.  A higher brick wall at the rear has a black marble (or possibly polished granite), dedicatory tablet with 78 and 460 squadron badges and further words stencilled onto the bricks.  In front of the engine another black tablet commemorates the crew of Halifax LV905 lost in action over Belgium.
